Rina B.: morning! day 1 here. quick q — trying to find the single source for onboarding docs and the standard Service Setup Checklist. in my team folder there are three copies. which one is canonical and how do i request edit rights?

Tara (DevEx): welcome Rina! :tada: Our canonical collection is the Onboarding Hub under the Engineering space (Workspace > Spaces > Engineering > Onboarding Hub). Read-only hub link is pinned in the workspace. Please duplicate the checklist template instead of editing masters. To get editor access for a short period, use the Notion edit request form and choose Onboarding Edit (timeboxed): https://forms.redwood.com/notion-edit-request — include the duplicate page URL and the reason.

Rina B.: thanks. another thing: some pages have a property called Sensitivity and others just use tags. which should i use when the checklist mentions infra details?

Lena (Docs Curator): good question. we standardized on a page property named Sensitivity with values Public, Internal, Restricted. Set the property on your draft. If you mark Sensitivity=Restricted you must submit the small Security review that the template header links to before we publish it widely.

Mateo (Security): quick security note: Restricted pages cannot contain secrets in-line. If the checklist references credentials, put them in the secrets vault and reference them like Vault://path. For any external sharing of Restricted content open a ticket at tickets.redwood.com/security-share. We do not allow ad-hoc external links for Restricted docs.

Rina B.: got it. workflow question: once my duplicate is ready, how do i promote it so other teams stop creating copies?

Tara (DevEx): our promotion flow is simple: 1) Duplicate the Service Setup Checklist template into your team area. 2) Fill the metadata block at the top: Owner, Version, Sensitivity, Compatibility (e.g., Dedicated, Private). 3) Post the draft link in #devex with a one-line rationale and tag the proposed owner. 4) Curator reviews and either approves, requests changes, or routes to Security. On approval, the curator moves the approved page into the Onboarding Hub and leaves a redirect note on the old drafts.

Lena (Docs Curator): naming guidance: name drafts like Team/Checklist - ServiceName - draft - initials (e.g., Platform/Checklist - Billing - draft - RB). After promotion we rename to [Team] - Checklist - ServiceName - v1.0 and update the Onboarding index. Please keep a short Change Log block at the top of your draft.

Rina B.: one more small thing: my teammate couldn't see the page in their sidebar. is there an auto-pin option?

Tara (DevEx): Notion doesn't auto-pin for other users. When the curator publishes the page in the Hub we add a pinned link to the team sidebar. If you need immediate visibility, post the link in your team channel and ask a space admin or curator to pin it temporarily.
